summary.name: ClipDrop
summary.one_liner: ClipDrop is a web-based suite of AI image tools for removing backgrounds, erasing objects or people, upscaling, relighting, and generating images from text.
use_cases: erase unwanted objects or people from photos
summary.what_it_does: ClipDrop offers a set of AI image tools in the browser: Remove background extracts the main subject, Cleanup removes objects, people, text and defects, and Image upscaler enlarges images 2x or 4x and can reduce noise. It also includes Text to image for generating high-resolution images, Replace background, Uncrop to extend photos to other formats, Relight, Text remover, and a Universal Resizer for social media sizes. The page states that background removal and Cleanup are free and mentions a Jasper API for embedding these image models in products. It also points to Clipdrop plugins for Photoshop via a desktop install.
notable: One-click AI background removal and object/person removal via Cleanup
Image upscaling by 2x or 4x with noise removal
Jasper API for embedding image models into products
caveats: Only background removal and Cleanup are described as free; other tools' pricing is not stated on the page
Photoshop integration requires installing Clipdrop on the desktop
